metadata.method_name: Held-out test of adopting-field gateway centrality for concept retention (H1) and concept-level gateway landing vs size-adjusted breadth (H3)
metadata.description: One zero-credit scan of the full OpenAlex works snapshot (2,040 parquet files); legacy concept lexicon (levels 2-5) + Wikidata aliases; Aho-Corasick title matching with stemmed verification; grounding by legacy concept tags validated on an LLM-labelled benchmark and a per-concept LLM precision gate; frozen dev specification (hashed) scored once on sealed held-out home groups and the 2010-2014 cohort.
metadata.baseline: X0 = B5 + log field size + phi(home,j) + relatedness density + P_j(-c) + coverage + episode size
metadata.method: X1 = X0 + frozen 1998-2002 eigenvector gateway centrality of the adopting field

H3_heldout.verdict_qualified: CONFIRMED (pre-registered Holm permutation test) -- small effect: within-group partial rho ~0.07

metadata_demo_subset: 100 DEV episodes (25 per dev home group CS/Eng/BGM/Med; 10 retained R=1 + 15 not retained R=0), seeded random sample from full_method_out.json dataset episodes_dev_LOGO_oof (9,079 episodes).
